name: IBY_TEMP_EXT_PARTY_PMT_MTHDS
description: IBY_TEMP_EXT_PARTY_PMT_MTHDS stores payment method applicability driven by the preference of a certain supplier. It serves as a staging table between iSupplier UI and the main IBY UI.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the temp instrument use

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLOW
columns.description: specify funds capture or disbursement flow. Value taken from lookup: IBY_PAYMENT_FLOW

columns.name: EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: External party identifier, either a payee or payer, depending on the payment flow.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function or purpose of the payment. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS include SUPPLIER_PAYMENT, CUSTOMER_REFUNDS and others

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if payment method is primary. Y for  yes, N otherwise.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when an explicit assignment of a payment method to an external payee becomes active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when an explicit assignment of a payment method to an external payee becomes inactive
